theorem lg_target {α : Type u_1} {β : Type u_2} [Preorder β] {f : Finset α → β} [DecidableEq α] : Monotone f ↔ ∀ (s : Finset α) ⦃a : α⦄, a ∉ s → f s ≤ f (insert a s) := by
  intro h
  split
  · intros s a ha
    exact h s (insert a s) ha
  · intros s t hst
    induction hst with x xs using Finset.induction_on
    · exact le_refl (f s)
    · have : t = insert x (s ∪ {x}) := by rfl
      rw [this]
      exact h s x (not_mem_insert x s)
